recipe.from_template: utility-gan_upscaler (UpscaleModelLoader -> ImageUpscaleWithModel, the video template's upscale stage applied to a still) + docs.comfy.org/tutorials/basic/upscale (Load Upscale Model -> Upscale Image (using Model)); esrgan_example (archived) is the same two nodes after a txt2img pass. Model swapped to the OpenModelDB record 4x-UltraSharpV2 (4x-UltraSharpV2.safetensors 139,792,588 B; Lite build 29,590,776 B).
recipe.confidence_note: official two-node graph; model choice per the OpenModelDB record (author description)

upscale_model.note: 4x-UltraSharpV2_Lite.safetensors (29.6 MB, faster); anime-only alternatives: 4x-AnimeSharp.safetensors (upscale-image-anime-animesharp), RealESRGAN_x4plus_anime_6B.pth (BSD-3, tiny/fast), 2x-AnimeSharpV4_RCAN.safetensors (2x, 'extremely faithful'), 4x_fatal_Anime_500000_G.pth, 4xHFA2kLUDVAESwinIR_light.pth (anime video frames)

image.note: the anime / cartoon (or mixed) still; output = input x 4

recipe.defaults_note: 4x. DAT2 is a transformer: many times slower than an ESRGAN model of the same scale (tiled internally, so it runs anywhere). NON-COMMERCIAL licence (CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0): swap to RealESRGAN_x4plus_anime_6B.pth for commercial anime work.

vram_evidence.usage: NOT FOUND (no official VRAM table; ImageUpscaleWithModel tiles internally at 512 px / 32 overlap and halves the tile on OOM down to 128 px, so any CUDA GPU runs it; speed, not VRAM, is the limit)
